messages:
maria_devrel: Hey team — quick thread to sync on the community tutorial roadshow + benchmark story + where leads should land. Goal: record two short workshop vids, one benchmark post, and a webinar the same week.
ben_marketing: Love it. Do we have dates locked? Need to loop in comms calendar.
ashley_growth: Tentative week of May 12th? That gives us 3.5 weeks to produce assets.
tom_engineer: May 12 works for engineering availability. Can do a 30–40m demo + 15m Q&A.
katie_content: For the benchmark post: we should target 1 clear performance chart (latency vs cost) + short how-to. Keep it <900 words.
maria_devrel: Agreed. Proposal: 2 workshop vids (15m each), webinar (60m), benchmark blog (900 words), tutorial repo + minimal ref app. Who volunteers to shepherd the repo?
tom_engineer: I can own the ref app and a small example script. Will push a starter by next Wed.
ben_marketing: I will own the webinar landing page, forms, and promotional cadence. Ashley can you own ads/email timing?
ashley_growth: Yep. Plan: email blast days -10, -3, +1. Also community posts on day -7 and day 0.
maria_devrel: Routing: we want community-signups (free tier) to go to the dev Slack flow; MQLs (enterprise interest) to go to Sales queue. Can leads-bot do that? @leads-bot any suggestions?
leads-bot: Suggestion: use tags in the form: "company_size", "use_case", "budget_range". If company_size > 500 OR budget_range includes "enterprise" -> route to #sales-inbound; otherwise -> #community-onboarding. Also add a score for repeat visitors.
katie_content: Can we add UTM mapping so marketing source is preserved? Example form payload:
```json
{
  "utm_source": "webinar",
  "utm_campaign": "dev-roadshow-may12",
  "company_size": "",
  "budget_range": "",
  "email": ""
}
```
ben_marketing: Perfect. For immediate gating, let's add a simple rule before routing: if email domain ends with large corp domain list -> tag enterprise. I'll assemble a list.
maria_devrel: Nice. Also onboard plan: community signups get an automated welcome + tutorial link; MQLs get a personalized follow-up from AE within 24h. Ashley, can growth set SLA?
ashley_growth: 24h SLA yes. We'll add a Slack notification to #sales-inbound with form snapshot.
tom_engineer: Quick ask re benchmarks — we need reproducibility steps in README (commands + expected numbers). I'll include a tiny script: `./run_bench.sh --model redwood-small --seq 512 --iters 100`.
katie_content: I'll draft the short benchmark narrative and put copy in docs for review by Friday.
ben_marketing: Promo plan: blog + tweet thread + 2 LinkedIn posts + email + community posts. CTA in all assets to the webinar page.
maria_devrel: Awesome. Can everyone drop a single deliverable + ETA in this thread? I'll compile into the project board.
ben_marketing: Landing page copy + form — ETA Wed (May 1).
tom_engineer: Starter ref app + bench script — ETA Wed (May 1).
katie_content: Blog draft + charts — ETA Fri (May 3).
ashley_growth: Email templates + ad creative — ETA Mon (Apr 29).
maria_devrel: Great. One last note: let's keep benchmark language comparative and honest (no hyperbolic claims). Use raw numbers and methodology snippet. :white_check_mark:
ben_marketing: Agreed. I'll coordinate with legal on the wording.
maria_devrel: Thanks all — I'll add routing rules to the repo and post PR for the welcomes. Ping me if anything slips. :rocket:
